videos.desc: A wild brown rabbit moves through grassy dunes at sunset. It hops between tufts, sits upright on its hind legs with ears tall, nibbles clover, washes its face with its paws and bounds away.

At night on a city sidewalk a rat scurries past a parked bike to a pizza box lying on a manhole cover. It stands up on its hind legs, sniffs the steam, grabs a slice and drags it across the pavement down into the open drain, cheese stretching behind.
A shark swims through a swirling ring of small silver fish above a coral reef, then glides right up to the camera and opens its tooth-filled mouth in extreme close-up.

A very woolly black-faced sheep grazes on a misty green hillside, lifts its head, bleats loudly with its mouth wide open right into the camera, then turns and trots off toward the flock in the distance.
A close-up of a brown-shelled snail gliding slowly across a wet stone path in the rain, leaving a silvery trail, stretching its antennae and climbing onto an orange autumn leaf.
A pale sand-colored snake slithers down a desert dune, leaving a winding track in the rippled sand, then coils up on a flat black rock and flicks its tongue at the camera.
In a park full of red autumn maples, a grey squirrel climbs a tree trunk, sits on a branch nibbling a nut by a tree hole, then dashes along a thin branch with an acorn in its mouth and leaps away.
A white swan glides on a calm lake, curls its long neck to preen its feathers, dips its orange beak, then rears up flapping its huge wings and splashes across the water past small dark ducks.

Three house cats stand fully upright on their hind legs in a row on a plaid bed, holding the pose like little soldiers. One by one they wobble, bat a paw at the camera and drop down, then rise to stand again.
A wild tiger pushes through tall dry grass in a jungle, wades chest-deep into a forest river, splashes and snarls toward the camera, then climbs out on the muddy bank.

A large male turkey struts around a farmyard in autumn, fanning out its huge brown tail feathers and gobbling, with other turkeys in the background. It hops up onto a hay bale and poses with its tail spread wide.
A sea turtle crawls across white sand between big rocks on a tropical beach, reaches the water and slides in. It then glides underwater over a coral reef and swims up toward the sparkling surface.

A storybook watercolor scene full of animals - an owl, giraffe, cow, zebra, hippo, dog, pig, goat, hen, lion cub and elephant - slowly turns from black-and-white to full color while printed labels fade away.
A grey wolf walks toward the camera across deep snow on a mountain ridge at dusk, pine forest behind it. It stops, lifts its head and howls, breath steaming in the cold, then turns and trots away.

A cartoon farm girl shears a fluffy sheep, hugs the huge pile of soft wool, spins it on a spinning wheel into a ball of yarn and knits a cream sweater. She then dresses the now-bald lamb in the sweater and it runs off happily across the field.

A cartoon flock of white ducks waddles down a winding gravel path through a bright green alpine valley. They walk one behind another in a long unbroken row, orange feet slapping the gravel, with dandelions, a wooden fence and a farmhouse on the hillside behind them.

A black labrador stands in a shallow forest creek with the water around its legs, head lowered towards the surface. A small brown frog swims slowly across the water just in front of its nose. The dog holds completely still and keeps its eyes fixed on the frog as it paddles away between the reflections of the ferns and trees.

A man in a white shirt and yellow rubber boots stands at the open door of a red barn on a muddy farmyard. Brown hens stream out of the doorway past him. A goat, a large black and pink pig and a goose come out next and walk after him, and the camera backs away as they come. Finally three white alpacas walk out of the barn and follow the camera closely, the leading one filling the frame with its face.
videos.said: Guys, it's not all sunshine and rainbows. Oh, wait. Hang on. It might actually be.

videos.desc: A husky with blue eyes sits on a teal leaf-patterned bed in front of a brown buttoned headboard. Two large plastic toy dinosaurs, a red-brown one and a dark grey one, are held up in front of it by hands out of shot, their jaws open and teeth bared, and they snap towards the dog from both sides. The husky opens its mouth, tips its head back and howls at them, then paws at the grey one. At the end the dinosaurs are set down on the bed and the husky sits between them panting with its tongue out.

A shot from the back of an open-topped sports car parked on a forest road. A big white Samoyed dog in a turquoise harness sits upright in the driver's seat with its front paws resting by the steering wheel, staring straight ahead through the windscreen. A beagle sits in the passenger seat with its tongue out, a grey cat perches on the centre console between them, and a raccoon looks over from the narrow rear seat. Tall pine trees and mist fill the view ahead; nobody moves and the car does not start.

An animated night scene on a rooftop ledge, with a full moon and the blurred lights of a city behind. Two plump pigeons are asleep side by side in a big twig nest, a teal one and a white and pink one, both with their eyes closed and their heads tipped together. The teal pigeon suddenly jerks awake, beats its wings and lifts out of the nest, hovering for a moment while the other stays fast asleep with its eyes still shut. He drops back down beside her and settles, but stays sitting bolt upright with his eyes wide open, staring into the dark while she sleeps on.
videos.said: It's here. Probably just a mosquito. Go back to sleep.

videos.desc: A night dive on white sand: two black-gloved hands hold out a small action camera and an octopus reaches out and takes it. The picture then becomes the octopus's own point of view — its head and arms in the foreground as it crawls low over the sand, past dark rocks, and down a narrow gully. It arrives in what looks like an underwater nightclub: glowing red jellyfish hang overhead like lamps, blue laser beams sweep the water, and a crowd of octopuses, one wearing white sunglasses, waves its arms and dances under the lights.

A camera mounted on a horse follows its day on a desert ranch. First a close-up of the horse's muzzle dripping water as it drinks from a concrete trough, red rock cliffs behind it. Then a barn corner where a trolley is stacked high with brightly coloured sacks of animal feed in red, blue, green, yellow and pink, with a green shovel leaning beside it. Then a black horse and a chestnut horse stand nose to nose eating pale green hay from a big round metal feeder at sunrise. Finally the horse walks down a dirt road lined with tall golden poplars.

Underwater on bright white sand in clear turquoise water. A green sea turtle is tangled in a heavy brown rope net, unable to move. Two snorkellers in fins hold the turtle steady and work at the ropes with their hands, then one cuts the strands away with a black-handled knife. They peel the net back off the shell and flippers. Freed, the turtle glides away over the pale sand, its shadow following beneath it.

Filmed from the audience of a circus. An elephant stands alone in the sawdust ring under a spotlight. A huge grey sheet is dropped from above and floats down over the elephant until the whole animal is hidden under the cloth, which spreads out across the ring floor. A performer in a dark red suit stands beside the covered shape with his arm out. The sheet is then pulled away and a white tiger with black stripes walks out where the elephant had been, padding across the ring towards the audience and snarling at the camera.

A man in a black T-shirt, jeans and mirrored sunglasses kneels in the dirt beside a weathered wooden barn, holding a hammer and laying out fresh pale timber boards. A big woolly ram with curled horns walks straight up behind him and shoves its head into his side, pushing him against the barn wall. He shouts, braces one hand on the wall and tries to keep working, but the ram butts him again and again. In the last shot he is sitting slumped on the ground with the hammer still in his hand, head back, while the ram stands over him.
videos.said: with spring right around the corner. Ow! Oh my God! I'm sick of these goats. We're definitely having lamb chops tonight. Oh my God.

videos.desc: A red dirt track through a dry pine forest. A white and chestnut sifaka lemur comes bounding down the track towards the camera, hopping upright on its back legs with its arms held out. It stops right in front of the camera, sitting up on its hind legs, and a woman's hand offers it a small piece of orange carrot, which it takes in both black hands and nibbles. While it eats, the hand reaches out and strokes the thick white fur of its chest and belly, running over it slowly again and again while the lemur sits still and lets her, staring straight into the camera with big orange eyes.
videos.said: Here, have some carrot. It's so silky, so soft.

videos.desc: A man in a white cap kneels on the tarmac drive outside a house and holds out both hands as an old golden retriever steps out of the open door towards him. He takes its head in both hands, rubs its ears and cheeks and kisses the top of its nose. The next shot is inside the open boot of a car, where the dog sits on a blanket beside him with a pink lead and licks at a small tub of vanilla ice cream he holds out. Then in the fenced back garden the dog runs to him across the grass and he crouches down, laughing, and rubs both hands through the fur of its back and sides.

A plastic storage box on a wooden floor is filled to the top with pink packing peanuts, and a ferret is digging in the middle of it with only its head showing. Pink peanuts lie scattered all over the floor. A long grey ribbed tube lies bent in a loop on the floor next to the box. Ferrets jump out of the box, run across the wooden floor, dive into one end of the tube and pop out of the other, while another ferret keeps swimming through the peanuts in the box.

A split-screen cartoon of the old fable. In the top half a brown hare bounds over a grassy hill, then sits down, then lies flat on its back asleep. In the bottom half a tortoise plods forward step by step with a purple butterfly beside it and never stops. Behind them the sky turns from green daylight to an orange sunset and then to a starry night with a crescent moon, and the tortoise is still walking.

A man in an Alaska cap and a black hood films himself from a canoe on a wide green river with bushes along the bank. Two brown bears are swimming in the water behind him and one of them comes right up alongside the boat. He keeps his face to the camera and turns only his eyes for a long sideways look at the bear beside him, then relaxes into a grin as it swims past.

An animated hen leads four yellow chicks across a frozen lake, one chick carrying a white daisy. The ice splits into sharp plates and gives way; the hen and a chick drop into the blue water below and sink among the bubbles. The hen swims up and breaks the surface holding the soaked chick against her chest, lifts it out onto solid ice, and stands over all the chicks huddled together again.

A grass field burns at dusk in an animated film. A hen snatches up her nest of chicks and flies low over the fire, then lands in a river and pushes through the current with the nest held above the water. She wades out on the far bank, sets the chicks down and drops onto the stones, worn out, while the wildfire still glows on the hillside behind her.

A hen runs over a grassy hilltop at sunset carrying a small cloth sack, then climbs a sheer grey rock face with the sack in her beak. At a ledge she tips grain out of the sack into a nest where three grey hawk chicks stretch up with their mouths open wide to be fed. At night the adult hawk lands in front of her beside the sack, wings spread and eyes hard on her.

A small curly apricot-coloured poodle puppy stands on a living-room carpet over a white dome-shaped ball machine with a yellow tennis ball sitting in its opening. The puppy takes the ball, the machine shoots it away down the room, and the puppy runs off after it. It comes back down the carpet with the ball in its mouth and drops it into the hole in the top of the machine, then waits for the next shot. The same round repeats.

On a blue tennis court in bright sun, an apricot goldendoodle stands next to an orange and white egg-shaped ball machine placed on the service line. A tennis ball is hit over the net towards the dog. The dog runs off across the court after it while a person stands waiting at the far baseline. The dog comes back to the machine with the yellow ball in its mouth, drops it into the opening on top and stands beside the machine waiting for the next ball.

Four parrots sit in a row on the back of a beige sofa in front of white curtains: a grey African grey, a white cockatoo with a yellow crest, a blue and gold macaw and a small green parrot. A hand holds a blue and white toy pistol up at them from below and 'shoots' one bird after another. Each parrot in turn flops sideways onto the sofa and lies there motionless with its feet in the air, playing dead, until the whole row has fallen over.
